title: Nature's Cover
description:
Your people's villages melt into the greenery, and you have learned to do the same.

If natural cover surrounds you (branches, driving rain, fog, falling snow or natural darkness), you use {{CACHER-001}} as part of {{CACNAT-001|this Skill}}, even in full light, and your {{jet}} ({{dexterite}} + {{discretion}}) to become {{cache}} gains 1 {{avantage}}.
